text: As Managebac Admin at SEK El Castillo, it is always gratifying to have a support team that responds quickly and efficiently.Daniel Carrera

This app indeed lacks simplicity. For parents, it doesn’t require a plethora of folders and tabs may be just a few relevant links and folders. Additionally, the search function doesn’t help even if you choose key words. You have to manually search folders and hierarchy to seek your content. Request team to make it simple. Thank you. KarmVik
ManageBac is a system that facilitates communication between teachers, students, and parents. Timely support is excellent, which makes it easy to use this platform. Alison Yang
